messages.text: Hi,     I have still not received a tracking number or any update since this email.      Have all orders been shipped?     Joseph

Hi Joseph,

Thanks for writing back, and I'm sorry you're still waiting on a tracking number after that update.

To answer your question directly: no, not every order has shipped yet. Some units have left the factory, and orders go out from our warehouse as their units are booked in. Each customer gets their tracking number by email as soon as their own order leaves.

I'd like to check exactly where yours is, but your message didn't come with an order number. Could you reply with it? It looks like Shop···· and it's on your order confirmation email. If you can't find it, the name and postcode ····ships to will work just as well. Once I have that, I'll look it up and tell you exactly where your order stands.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Joseph,

Thanks, I've found your order, Shop····. It's for two Magic M. 40Ts going to (address hidden), and it's paid. Neither unit has shipped yet, so there's no tracking number yet. You haven't missed anything.

I'm sorry this has run so far past the original October 31 date. Since our November 8 email, the units have left the factory and are on their way to our US warehouse. They haven't arrived there yet. Your order now ships by November 30, and both miners go out together.

When they leave, the tracking number comes straight to this email address. You can follow the shipment to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah, 

Okay I understand, unfortunately for me the website actually originally stated that Batch 3 of the Magic M. 40T would release for ordering on September 18 and ship September 30 so this experience has been less than ideal.

Joseph

Hi Joseph,

You're right. The page said Batch 3 would ship September 30, and we didn't keep that date. Then we missed the next one too, and we didn't keep you updated well enough in between. That's on us, and I'm sorry.

Here's where things stand. Your two 40Ts are built, they've left the factory, and they're on their way to our US warehouse now. Your order ships by November 30, and the tracking number comes to this address when it does.

We emailed you on November 3 to apologise for the delay, and that email had a $50 code for your next order: ····. It's yours whenever you'd like to use it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

It's alright I spoke with Abel about it back in September. He apologized and told me the website had the wrong date and to expect it to ship end of October. I understand delays happen and that now the units have shipped to local warehouses so am hoping orders ship out to us by the end of this month.

Hi Joseph,

Thanks for being so understanding, and for filling me in on what Abel told you in September.

One small correction so you're not caught out. The units are on their way to our US warehouse, but they haven't arrived yet. Once they land and are checked in, your two 40Ts ship by November 30. That's the date on your order, so you're right to plan around the end of this month. Your tracking number will come to this email address as soon as they leave.

There's nothing else you need to do, and nothing still open on your side. Our November 3 email also included a $50 code for your next order, ····, in case it went to your spam folder.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
